explanation: The notebook computes RMSD analyses of AdK domain motion. Three terminal result tables remain accessible at script completion in named DataFrames (df, df_mass, df_charge), each backed by its RMSD analysis object. The export code appends after the baseline, creates /work/outputs, and writes each existing DataFrame to CSV without recomputation. The first whole-trajectory backbone/CORE/LID/NMP RMSD analysis is excluded because both its DataFrames (R and df) were overwritten by the later CA-only analysis, and the single open-vs-closed backbone RMSD scalar is only an unnamed standalone expression.
